digest.component_or_area: bridge state storage format and migration
propositions: Document three committed format changes to .bridge_state (A2 last_get_pass relocation, A3 scalar baseline normalization, A4-2 prev_snapshot narrowing) plus A1 baseline_advanced_at deletion with rollback boundaries and mixed-version read protocol.

The mixed-version protocol reads chronological max(new, legacy) and requires direct deployment evidence (A2-1 merge, successful descendant reconcile-bridge.yml run, explicit host-probe refresh) before stopping legacy writes.

Bridge state remains committed on-branch because ephemeral runners need durable state; rolled-back A3 and A4-2 are each reversible through idempotent canonicalization and recorded corpus evidence respectively, while A2-2 supports rollback only to A2-1-or-newer.

Assignee field excluded from normalization because _assignee_candidates requires its raw shape; measurement shows 12.79 KB to 1.74 KB marginal cost after A1 with 218/399 identical prev key sets per session log 1cb6-d553-6565-49b4.

ADR relates mixed-version protocol to expand/contract migrations pattern in docs/migrations.md and prior epic 6c9c file/ref cutover, with committed store-compat fail-closed gate and 352b legacy-mirror retirement precedent.
No pass-record version stamp available for A2-2 gate timing; direct evidence of host probe refresh with executable/source recorded and no older process running replaces elapsed-time criteria.
